description: Delegated-versus-direct evaluation lane (mini-agent-964ao). Each task runs twice with scripts/delegation_eval.py: once with the task tool enabled, once with [subagents] task_enabled = false. The fixtures are small on purpose; a recorded baseline belongs next to this file as baseline.json.

tasks.name: cross_file_callers
tasks.prompt: Find every file under src/ that calls load_config and write their paths, sorted, one per line, to answer.txt.

tasks.name: known_path_read
tasks.prompt: Read version.txt and write its content, unchanged, to answer.txt.

tasks.name: independent_questions
tasks.prompt: Count the TODO markers in docs/ and in src/, then write answer.txt with exactly two lines: `docs: <count>` and then `src: <count>`.
